subject: Headcount approval: runtime & infra engineers (Q2)
messages:
From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>
To: Maya Srinivasan <maya_srinivasan@redwood.ai>; Michael Grant <michael_grant@redwood.ai>; Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>; Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
Cc: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 15 Feb 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Headcount approval: runtime & infra engineers (Q2)

Team —

Requesting headcount approval for two engineering hires on the runtime/platform side for Q2. Quick summary below, full details attached (hc_request_q2_runtime_infra.pdf + comp_bands_runtime_infra.xlsx):

Why now:
- Production load on serving runtime has increased 37% YTD; request latency variance spikes during peak bursts.
- We need dedicated ownership for KV cache improvements (runtime) and autoscaler resiliency (infra) to hit our Q3 SLA targets.

Roles requested (2 FTE):
1) Senior Software Engineer — Runtime (L5) — primary: attention optimizations, kernel tuning, KV cache lifecycle.
2) Software Engineer — Infrastructure (L4) — primary: autoscaling, observability hooks, deployment automation.

Comp bands & cost: see comp_bands_runtime_infra.xlsx. Estimated FY fully-burdened cost (headcount + equity + benefits): ~$320k for L5, ~$200k for L4 (US-market midpoint). Total incremental run-rate ~ $520k/year.

Asks:
- Approval to open both reqs and commit to hiring plan for Q2.
- Finance: confirmation that we can absorb incremental run-rate within FY26 hiring envelope or guidance on phasing.
- Recruiting: proposed timeline and sourcing plan so we can begin outreach next week.

If helpful I can split the reqs (approve one now, one contingent). Please respond with approval/feedback by EOD Tuesday so we can begin.

Thanks,
Markus
Markus Klein
Director, Serving Runtime
Redwood Inference
From: Maya Srinivasan <maya_srinivasan@redwood.ai>
To: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>
Cc: Michael Grant <michael_grant@redwood.ai>; Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>; Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>; Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 15 Feb 2026 11:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Headcount approval: runtime & infra engineers (Q2)

Thanks Markus — good, concrete ask. I approve in principle but have a few caveats and requests before final sign-off: 

1) Narrowing scope: please provide 6–8 bullet outcomes for the first 90 days for each role (so we can tie to OKRs).
2) Level justification: for the runtime role, the current L5 ask is justified but show an L4 cost option in the attachment for finance comparisons.
3) Hiring panel: recommend Michael + one infra engineer + one applied-ml infra engineer on the interview loop.

Copying Evelyn since she'll need to ok the final headcount and cost trade-off. Lauren — can you confirm whether we have room in the Q2 hiring envelope to cover both hires now, or whether we should phase?

If we can get the short 90-day outcomes + L4/L5 cost variants by Monday noon I can route for Evelyn's final approval.

Onward,
Maya
VP, Engineering
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
To: Maya Srinivasan <maya_srinivasan@redwood.ai>; Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>
Cc: Michael Grant <michael_grant@redwood.ai>; Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 16 Feb 2026 08:07:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Headcount approval: runtime & infra engineers (Q2)

On Mon, Feb 15, 2026 at 11:03 AM Maya Srinivasan <maya_srinivasan@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Thanks Markus — good, concrete ask. I approve in principle but have a few caveats...

Markus / Maya —
I reviewed the attachments. We can likely fund both hires but want to see the following before finalizing: 
- A run-rate sensitivity model with: base salary ranges, on-target equity amortization, employer taxes/benefits, and ramp windows (use budget_impact_model_v1.xlsx).
- A scenario that phases the infra hire as a 6-month contractor converted to FTE (midpoint cost delta ~ -22% in year one).

If you can provide the sensitivity table and a one-slide summary of net headcount vs. budget impact, I can sign off. Otherwise recommend opening only the runtime req now and deferring infra to next quarter.

-lauren
Lauren Bishop
Head of Finance, Redwood Inference
From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
To: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>; Maya Srinivasan <maya_srinivasan@redwood.ai>
Cc: Michael Grant <michael_grant@redwood.ai>; Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 16 Feb 2026 09:34:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Headcount approval: runtime & infra engineers (Q2)

Markus / team —
I can start candidate outreach immediately if we get the green light. Quick recruiter notes: 
- For the L5 runtime role I recommend a blended search: 60% outreach to incumbent L5/L6 runtime engineers (Bay Area + remote), 30% partner referrals, 10% targeted ads.
- Typical window to an offer: 6–8 weeks for L5; for L4 infra expect 4–6 weeks.
- Our comp band spreadsheet (attached) includes relative market levels; midpoints: L5 total comp ~ $320k, L4 ~ $200k. We can target ~75th percentile for L5 given scarcity of kernel/runtime talent.

I attached an initial pipeline plan and drafted job description edits. If Lauren prefers the contractor path for infra, I can open a vendor brief with contractor-sourcing@talentpartners.io and push an approved SOW option.

—Aditya
Senior Talent Partner
From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>
To: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>; Maya Srinivasan <maya_srinivasan@redwood.ai>; Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>; Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 16 Feb 2026 11:04:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Headcount approval: runtime & infra engineers (Q2)

Thanks all — I reviewed the updated attachments and notes. Approve as follows: 

- Approve opening the Senior Software Engineer — Runtime (L5) immediately.
- Approve the Infrastructure (L4) role on a conditional, phased basis: start as a 6-month contractor with intent to convert to FTE if key autoscaler and observability milestones are met.

Conditions/details:
- Markus to deliver 90-day outcome bullets for both roles (Maya requested) and a one-slide budget summary for Finance by end of week.
- Recruiting: prioritize offers by quality; do not accelerate salary above the proposed comp band midpoint without prior approval.

Markus — please proceed to open the L5 req in Greenhouse and kick off vendor SOW for the contractor infra candidate. Copy HR on the SOW.

Regards,
Evelyn Hart
CTO, Redwood Inference
